'''Douglas Ellwanger''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 23rd, 2 (−60) at [[RamapoCon II Constructed (5 May, 7 pm)]] on 5 May 2000, according to Scott Lingrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d720">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-10-rcon-ii-day-1-and-before-director-sd720/ rcon-ii-day-1-and-before-director-s], DeckTech (Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell, 10 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-10-rcon-ii-day-1-and-before-director-sd720/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
